newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania to hold fresh round of talks with NATO on its plans to integrate into the Western alliance.
Foreign ministry state secretary Lazar Comanescu and defence state secretary Ioan Mircea Pascu to meet NATO officials in Brussels next week.
* Daniel Tarschys, Secretary General of the Council of Europe, is expected to visit Romania and meet Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu this week.
* Amoco Corp has decided to close oil products marketing operations in Romania, Doru Badulescu, head of Romanian Agency for Mineral resources said.
Badulescu said the decision was taken by U.S.-based company which wants to focus on markets in the Americas and to pull out of Eastern European markets.
* Badulescu said Enterprise Oil Exploitation continues drills in Romanian oil blocks in the Black Sea. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
